rules: I and B: take one in-range display card or draw one deck card. F: 3–5 research icons give 1 conservation; 6+ give 2.
R: each research icon played into your zoo gives 1 reputation.
I: 2/5/10 money for 1/2/3 universities. R: supporting conservation projects requires strength 4 rather than 5. F: 1 conservation for three universities.
I: 2 money per research icon. R: each research icon played gives 1 conservation.
I: 2 reputation and 1 conservation.
I: 2 appeal per previously supported project (count tokens missing from the left map edge). B: 1 conservation.
I: 1 conservation per two different continent/animal-category icons; each other player gets 2 money per conservation point you gain.
I: 1 appeal per research icon. R: whenever any player plays a research icon, **you, the Science Library owner, gain 2 money**. F: 1 conservation with five different animal categories.
I and B: 1 X-token. F: 1 conservation for three universities.
I: 1 appeal per Americas icon. R: each Americas icon played permits a free kiosk under normal placement and spacing rules. F: 1 conservation with five or more kiosks.
I: 1 appeal per Europe icon. R: each Europe icon played permits a free size-1 standard enclosure under normal placement rules. F: 1 conservation with five or more occupied size-1 enclosures.
I: 1 appeal per Australia icon. R: per Australia icon played you may tuck one hand card beneath this Sponsor for 2 appeal; tucked cards have no further function.
I: 1 appeal per Asia icon. R: each Asia icon played permits a free pavilion under normal placement rules.
I: 1 appeal per Africa icon. R: each Africa icon played permits moving any Action card to slot 1 **after finishing** the action. F: 1 appeal per held X-token.

I: put two supply tokens on the Sponsor. When supporting a **base project below the Association board**, you may return exactly one token as any one icon; never both on the same support. Base-origin cards played above the board do not qualify. F: 1 conservation with five or more project supports, counted by missing left-map tokens.
I: activate one worker as with Full-throated. F: 1 conservation at reputation 9+.

Each Build action may add **one extra copy of a building built in that same Build action**, without additional strength. Pay normal money and observe placement; special enclosures still have a one-per-type limit. Even with several different buildings, only one extra building is allowed. F: 5 appeal with a full map except water/rock.

I: **2 money per water/rock icon**. R: You may cover water/rock spaces and ignore terrain requirements of animals and unique buildings; their printed terrain icons still count. Terrain need not be covered for a full map. Covered terrain stops counting for Hydrologist, Geologist and Architectural Zoo. F: 2 appeal per water-icon/rock-icon pair, maximum three pairs.
I and B: 3 money. F: 1 conservation at reputation 9+.

Every actual placement bonus on a border space grants an additional choice of any **uncovered** placement bonus on your map, not necessarily on the border. Several border bonuses permit several extra choices; the copied bonuses can be the same or different. Resolve bonuses in your chosen order. F: 1 conservation when all building border spaces are covered (exclude water/rock).
I: 1 conservation per research icon, maximum 3; every other player gains 2 money for each point you receive.

I: 1 X-token. Each Release into the Wild support gives 1 additional conservation. You may repeatedly support the same release project with different qualifying animals, but place at most one token per project per Association action. Each token counts as a separate project support for other effects.
I: 1 X-token. Immune to Venom, Constriction, Hypnosis and Pilfering. For the latter two, ignore your counters and find the next qualifying player. F: 1 conservation with all five continents.
I: 2 reputation. F: 1 conservation with all five continents.

Choose small or large permanently; mark the chosen box with a player token from your supply. Reveal deck cards until finding that type of animal; keep it and discard the others. From now on chosen small animals give 2 extra appeal, or chosen large animals 4. You cannot play the opposite type. Size-3 animals remain legal but gain no bonus.

I: 2 money per small animal. An Animals action containing **only small animals** means you may play one additional small animal **from hand** with normal costs/rules, then add one small animal from the display to hand regardless of reputation. You may take the display animal even if you declined the additional play. Mixing small and large animals in the original action prevents this effect.
I: 1 appeal per small animal. R: small animals cost 3 money less.
I: 2 appeal per large animal. R: large animals cost 4 money less.

card: 231–235 Sponsorship: Primates / Reptiles / Vultures / Lions / Elephants
rules: Respectively primate/reptile/bird/predator/herbivore icons. I: 1 appeal per matching icon. B: 3/6/9 money for 1–2/3–4/5+ matching icons.

card: 236–240 Primatologist / Herpetologist / Ornithologist / Expert in Predators / Expert in Herbivores
rules: For each respective primate/reptile/bird/predator/herbivore icon played in **any zoo**, gain 3 money per icon.

I: 1 appeal per water icon. R: each space newly covered adjacent to water gives 1 money, even if several spaces belong to one building; a space adjacent to several water hexes still pays only once. F: 1 conservation if all water hexes are connected (none isolated).
I: 3 appeal per two rock icons, round down. R: as Hydrologist but rocks. F: 1 conservation if all rock hexes are connected.

card: 243 Meerkat Den; 244 Penguin Pool; 245 Aquarium; 246 Aerial Cableway; 247 Baboon Rock
rules: Place their unique buildings adjacent respectively to 1 rock, 1 water, 2 water, 2 rock, 1 rock. R: respectively each herbivore, bird, water, rock, primate icon played gives 2 appeal. F: 1 conservation with six or more corresponding icons.
Place the unique building. R: each primate icon played gives 1 X-token.
Place the unique building. R: each bird icon played draws two deck cards; keep one, discard the other.
Place adjacent to water. R: each reptile icon played lets you sell up to two hand cards for 4 money each; discard sold cards.
Place adjacent to water. R: each bear icon played in **any zoo** gives 2 appeal. F: 3–5 bear icons give 1 conservation; 6+ give 2.

Place adjacent to rock. R: each predator icon played uses Hunter with draws equal to your total predator icons. A double-predator card triggers two sequential Hunters, counting both new icons each time.

Place the building and three supply tokens on its card. Per herbivore icon played, you may spend one token and **pay money equal to a hand Sponsor’s level** to play that Sponsor, observing its normal conditions. Its own icon can trigger this when the Stable is played. Three uses total.
I: 1 reputation, 1 conservation, place its building covering at least two border spaces, take one in-range display card or draw one deck card. Resolve simultaneous benefits in your chosen order.
I: 4 appeal and place their unique building next to at least one rock or water hex respectively.

Place on two border spaces; unlike ordinary buildings it need not touch an existing building. Other placement rules apply. Later buildings may attach to it. B: 2 money per adjacent building except empty standard enclosures; it may stand beside a kiosk. F: 5 appeal with a full map excluding water/rock.
I: 1 appeal per connected water/rock hex respectively. F: 1 conservation per two isolated corresponding terrain hexes, round down.

I: 1 appeal per connected uncovered **building** border space (never water/rock). F: 1 conservation per six contiguous empty building spaces; count restricted spaces even if Build is not upgraded. Evaluate each group separately: groups of 13,6,3,2 give 2+1+0+0 = 3 points.
I: 1 conservation and 1 appeal. F: 1 conservation with five or more animal-category icons, including bear and Petting Zoo animal.

I: 2 money per **different** continent/animal-category icon (research does not count). R: each category/continent newly introduced to your zoo gives 1 appeal and 2 money; a double of the same new icon grants the novelty benefit only once.

I: you may place a size-5 standard enclosure free under normal placement rules. R: when playing a large animal, ignore one left-side condition (one required icon, or the Animals upgrade, for example). Terrain requirements cannot be ignored. Stacks with Research Institute to ignore two conditions.
I: 1 appeal per connected uncovered placement-bonus space. F: 1 conservation per two isolated placement-bonus spaces, round down.
